verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's docs describe built-in retry logic in the Router, configurable via num_retries. The docs also list timeouts, cooldowns and retries with fixed or exponential backoff across deployments and providers, with automatic fallback to another model group once retries are used up. Missing for 10: documentation of per-error-type retry policies (which transient errors trigger retries), and independent or hands-on confirmation that retries behave as described.
